jobs.description: As a logistics employee, you play an important role in the warehouse and distribution process. You make sure goods are handled safely, correctly and on time.Your tasks are:- Loading and unloading trucks.- Packing, sorting and labelling products.- Preparing orders and processing returns.- Checking the quality and quantity of goods.- Registering your work in the system.- Solving small deviations and keeping the warehouse tidy.- Moving goods with an EPT and sometimes with a forklift.You work from Monday to Friday in 2 shifts.
